notes.title: Lunar New Year 2020 update!
notes.content:
Hey all, 

We've just pushed out a new update for Planet Protector VR. Our store page screenshots won't match these just yet but the core game is still "shoot aliens, protect the city". 

The update is focused on better support for OpenVR / SteamVR devices as well as bringing some optimization & code changes due to a change in our Unity engine version upgrade.

Let us know what you think of the update! We'll be getting out of Steam Early Access soon, so feedback to make our release awesome would be wicked! 

See you around, protectors!

notes.title: Overhaul Incoming!
notes.content:
Hey all! Sometime soon, we'll be releasing an overhauled version of Planet Protector VR.

This overhaul comes from player feedback at RTX Sydney 2018 and Supanova Sydney 2018, with the overhaul specifically being tested at Supanova.

I don't have many screenshots to show at this time, though I can happily confirm a few little points:


 The game runs much, much smoother now.
 The game looks much, much prettier (bye-bye smartphone limitations!)
 The game has a variety of new enemies to play against.

This updated version of the game will come to Steam soon - I'll make another announcement soon before that happens, but I'm looking at a July/September update for now.

I know this has been our only update so far -- development has been slow due to other work popping up. I'm grateful for all of your support, believe me! 
If you do want more frequent updates, it might be best to follow BigfootDS on Facebook since I post regularly there.

Thankyou for your support and patience, this game is improving bit by bit! I'll post again soon. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Game Plans & PAXAUS2017 News
notes.content:
Hey friends! 

So it's been almost a fortnight since the game's launch - we've let things simmer and settle, and now it's time to reveal the next stage of our early-access process. 

Game Showcase
First off, if you're attending PAXAUS2017 you'll see Planet Protector VR live & ready for players at both the AIT (Academy of Information Technology) booth and the AIE (Academy of Interactive Entertainment) booth throughout the weekend. 

As a solo dev I'll be bouncing back and forth between the booths, and the game will be running all weekend at AIT's booth and for half of the weekend at AIE's booth. Feel free to drop in to either booth and grab some epic stickers and other cool game loot! 

Development Update
Secondly, this game is in early-access and its development is still ongoing - so here's the plan! 
--- RTX SYDNEY 2018 --- 
An updated build of the game will launch in time for RTX Sydney 2018. We tested out this build at PAXAUS 2017 and it went really well, so development there is going smoothly. We'll keep testing out new builds at local expos & conventions, and then push them online once they're ready. Keep an eye out for that!

And remember, there are feedback & suggestions forms available too - help us be awesome! 

-- The bug/error reporting form
-- The content suggestion form

See you around, planet protectors!

notes.title: Planet Protector VR is available tomorrow!
notes.content:
Hey all! Planet Protector VR becomes available for purchase tomorrow! 
This game is still an early access title and will be so for a while, allowing us to add more content & improve the quality of the game as per your feedback.

To leave some awesomly-helpful feedback, please use these links below:
 The bug/error reporting form.
 The content suggestion form. 

See you on the other side of the game launch! We hope you and your friends & family all enjoy Planet Protector VR!
